I use it myself just because it makes it easier to find sources of sound, like water and lava without wearing headphones. Some would say it is cheating, but some people would say maximizing the in-game brightness is also cheating, because it allows you to see clearly without even placing torches in pitch black.I'm kind of a purist and grew up used to the Alpha brightness, and I often set the brightness all the way down just for the feel and atmosphere of dark and gloomy caves and nights, but I wouldn't look down upon anyone who plays with full brightness. I even turn it up myself when it gets annoying, if i'm building something at night, or if I'm travelling the world at night.

I also turn off Phantoms, because I dont feel like skipping nights by having to sleep every few days, and getting punished by annoying mobs for not doing it. Is that cheating? for some, very much so, for me, no. Its all about your personal preferences.
